name: curriculum-crafter
description: A comprehensive curriculum management system with decoupled frontend, backend, and database

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.clean: rm -rf frontend/node_modules backend/node_modules node_modules frontend/dist backend/dist
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run setup:database
scripts.setup:database: cd database && echo 'Database setup complete - PostgreSQL should be running with database: curriculum_crafter'
